title: leucanthemum integrifolium
intro: Leucanthemum integrifolium, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a flowering plant species native to Europe and Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Everlasting include wound healing, reduction of fever, and relief from respiratory issues, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been shown to exhibit immunomodulatory and antiproliferative activities.
